summary_1line: Bhishma tells Yudhishthira that Brahmanas deserve highest reverence and protection, praising learning, charity, and penance while warning of the power of ascetic wrath.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, pierced by countless arrows on the battlefield, speaks calmly to Yudhishthira and the gathered princes who listen in reverent silence.
Wise Brahmanas in white robes stand in a royal court, speaking like a flock of swans while kings listen respectfully.
A humble king offers clean, steaming food with bowed head to seated Brahmanas during a sacred meal.
